 Jaipur EPFO Enforcement Officer Arrested for Accepting Rs 1 Lakh Bribe
  04 Nov-2026 16:52 PM 
 Listen 
 Stop 
 By:  FirstIndia 
 Jaipur : The Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) arrested Sonu Maurya, an Enforcement Officer with the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), Jaipur, for allegedly accepting a bribe of Rs 1 lakh. 
 According to the ACB, the accused had demanded Rs 2 lakh from a complainant in exchange for not registering an FIR against his firm over non-deposit of employees' provident fund contributions and not freezing its bank accounts. Verification of the complaint confirmed a bribe demand of Rs 1 lakh. 
 The ACB team subsequently laid a trap and caught Maurya red-handed while accepting Rs 1 lakh in the presence of the firm's chartered accountant. 
 The operation was conducted under the supervision of Additional Superintendent of Police Manoj Kumar Gupta. The ACB is also questioning the accused about the possible involvement of other individuals. Further investigation under the Prevention of Corruption Act is underway.
